description: This file defines data models used within the Mission Management UI of the application, including classes for User, Donation, Volunteer, MissionProject, ActivityItem, and OverviewStats, as well as their related properties and documentation.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user of the application with identification, name, email, and roles.

classes.name: Donation
classes.description: Represents a donation with donor details, amount, date, and status.

classes.name: Volunteer
classes.description: Represents a volunteer with personal and regional information.

classes.name: MissionProject
classes.description: Represents a mission project with identification, name, region, and status.

classes.name: ActivityItem
classes.description: Represents an activity or event with title, subtitle, timestamp, and ID.

classes.name: OverviewStats
classes.description: Aggregated statistics for overview metrics such as donations, volunteers, projects, and tasks.
